topics.topic: Ownership of the normative audit action catalog membership
questions: Which module owns the normative membership of the audit action catalog: `models`, `audit_writer`, or a specified split between them?

quotes:
A consumer owns exactly the rules and parts of a decision its own section
names; the primary owner owns every other rule of the decision.

The State 1 records M01–M37, their projections and answers, the request
models, the repository interfaces and the runtime models, as plain frozen typed
data with their closed enumerations (A24). No behaviour beyond the local
validators of their closed choices (State 1 modeling conventions).

A13 and A23: validation of an `AuditIntent` against the closed catalogue, the
significant-mutation actions and the result and reason policy, and the append
of exactly one AuditRecord per occurrence, including the rejected records
A13 names and service key-version provenance.

_validate_audit_intent: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST reject an action that is not an AuditAction member and MUST enforce the result and reason combination: a success record carries no reason_code, a rejected record of a significant mutation carries a non-blank reason_code, and a rejected record of any other action may carry one or none;
judgement.why: No admissible witness exists because the texts define a closed AuditAction enumeration and authorize no event that adds a member or creates an independent audit_writer catalog; every currently admissible action therefore has the same validation outcome.
